title: Netherlands vs Greece 7–0: Reijnders Hat-Trick in 21 Minutes 🤯 #shorts
description:
The Netherlands beat Greece 7–0 in the UEFA Nations League at the Johan Cruijff Arena on 13 November 2026, tying the record for the biggest win in Nations League history. Tijjani Reijnders scored a hat-trick between the 12th and 33rd minutes, Jurriën Timber scored twice and Crysencio Summerville and Donyell Malen also scored. It was the first time Greece had conceded seven since May 1989, and Xavi's Netherlands play Germany in Berlin on Monday.

title: Argentina vs Uruguay 1–2: First Game Without Messi 😳 #shorts
description:
Uruguay beat Argentina 2–1 in a friendly at La Bombonera on 13 November 2026, Argentina's first match since Lionel Messi's international retirement in October. Leonardo Balerdi scored an own goal and Maximiliano Araújo doubled the lead for Diego Forlán's Uruguay before Julián Álvarez pulled one back. Lionel Scaloni, who has extended his contract through 2030, left the No. 10 shirt unassigned.

title: Bam Adebayo & Giannis 37 Each | Heat vs Cavaliers 🔥 #shorts

Davion Mitchell added 22 points and a career-high-tying 17 assists, and Donovan Mitchell scored 25 for Cleveland.
